product.description:

K-Brightening Face Bar is a powerful, yet gentle cleansing formula designed to enhance your skin’s natural radiance. Enriched with advanced brightening actives and nourishing natural extracts, it helps improve uneven skin tone while keeping the skin soft and balanced.

Lather with water and apply to damp face. Massage gently for a few seconds, then rinse thoroughly. Use daily for best results.
